proved_interfaces.statement: For every restriction-critical Boolean f, 0<=Ddual(S)<=sum_i JS_i<=(2/ln2) I(f).
For every epsilon>0, restriction-critical Boolean f with Ddual(S)>=epsilon H(S) satisfies H(f)<=(2/(epsilon ln2)) I(f).

remaining_lemma.quantifiers: Determine whether H/I is uniformly bounded on all genuine Boolean f that are restriction-critical, tensor-prime, satisfy max_i I_i<=e^3*2^(-H/I), and have Ddual(S)/H(S) arbitrarily small; alternatively derive a complete signed-Booleanity or nonlocal restriction contradiction for that simultaneous regime.

not_claimed: a uniform positive lower bound on Ddual/H
